# Percona Distribution for MySQL 9.7

> Percona Distribution for MySQL 9.7, a tested bundle of Percona Server for MySQL or XtraDB Cluster with HAProxy, ProxySQL, XtraBackup and other tools, with installation, upgrade and operations guides

Each page below is also available as markdown. For the documentation of all Percona products, see https://docs.percona.com/llms.txt.

## Uninstall

- [Uninstalling Percona Distribution for MySQL](https://docs.percona.com/percona-distribution-for-mysql/9.7/uninstalling.md): To uninstall Percona Distribution for MySQL, stop the mysql service and remove all the installed packages using the package manager of your operating system. Optionally, disable Percona repository.
